    The D̃₆ shape of BO13a figure 6.1 #

    Two sinks y₀, y₁ joined through a source m (y₀ ← m → y₁), with two further arrows into each sink: t₀ → y₀ ← x₀ and x₁ → y₁ ← t₁ (RayQuiver.MulBasis.not_d6s). Also a builder RayCat.copyD for copies of D̃ₘ.
